name: Auto Redirect 404 to Custom URL
author: Nitya Saha

sections.description:
Auto Redirect 404 to Custom URL is a lightweight WordPress plugin that automatically redirects all 404 (Page Not Found) errors to a custom URL or your site’s homepage. Stop losing visitors and improve your SEO by eliminating broken links and fixing 404 errors reported in Google Search Console.

When visitors land on a broken link or deleted page, they’re automatically redirected to your chosen destination instead of seeing an error page. This keeps users engaged and prevents them from leaving your site.

Key Features

  • Custom URL Redirection – Redirect 404 errors to any URL of your choice
  • Homepage Redirection – Optionally redirect to your WordPress homepage
  • SEO-Friendly 301 Redirects – Permanent redirects that preserve SEO value
  • Fix Google Search Console Errors – Resolve 404 errors reported in GSC
  • Easy Configuration – Simple settings page in WordPress admin
  • Lightweight & Fast – No bloat, minimal performance impact
  • Automatic Detection – Works instantly after activation
  • Compatible with All Themes – Works with any WordPress theme

Why Use This Plugin?

404 errors negatively impact:
* User experience – visitors leave frustrated
* SEO rankings – search engines penalize broken links
* Conversion rates – potential customers bounce away
* Site credibility – broken pages look unprofessional

This plugin solves these problems automatically with proper 301 redirects.

Perfect For

  • Fixing 404 errors after site migrations
  • Redirecting deleted pages and posts
  • Improving Google Search Console health
  • Enhancing user experience on older sites
  • SEO optimization and link management

Support the Developer

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Auto Redirect 404 to Custom URL”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Go to Settings > Auto Redirect 404s to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the auto-redirect-404s folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Navigate to Settings > Auto Redirect 404s to configure your redirect URL

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Settings > Auto Redirect 404s
  2. Enter your custom redirect URL (or leave blank to use homepage)
  3. Click Save Changes
  4. Test by visiting a non-existent page on your site
sections.faq:
Can I redirect 404 errors to any URL?

Yes! You can redirect to any valid URL – internal pages, external websites, or custom landing pages.

Does this plugin use 301 redirects?

Yes, the plugin uses SEO-friendly 301 (permanent) redirects, which is the recommended approach for handling missing pages.

Will this fix 404 errors in Google Search Console?

Yes! Implementing 301 redirects is one of the recommended solutions for resolving 404 errors in Google Search Console. The errors should disappear after Google recrawls your site.

What happens if I don’t enter a custom URL?

If you leave the redirect URL field empty, all 404 errors will automatically redirect to your site’s homepage.

Does this affect site performance?

No, the plugin is extremely lightweight and has minimal impact on site performance. It only activates when a 404 error occurs.

Can I redirect different 404 pages to different URLs?

This version redirects all 404 errors to a single URL. For advanced redirect rules, consider using a dedicated redirect management plugin.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes! This plugin works independently of your theme and is compatible with all WordPress themes.

Can I use this with other redirect plugins?

Yes, but be aware that if you have multiple redirect plugins, they may conflict. This plugin is designed to handle all 404 errors specifically.
